item.title: New ransom note in Nancy Guthrie case graphically details consequences of not meeting demands
item.description: A new ransom note has reportedly emerged weeks after the disappearance of “Today” show co-host Savannah Guthrie’s mother, Nancy Guthrie. The latest communication, which TMZ reported receiving, includes a demand for millions of dollars in cryptocurrency and a graphic description of the consequences of not paying the ransom. #NancyGuthriedisappearance #TMZ #ransomnote #SavannahGuthrie #missingperson

item.title: Liberty University students warned Satan uses phones, devices to 'separate us from God' as part of 'digital rest' launch
item.description: Liberty University has rolled out a 28-day challenge throughout February inviting students to step away from social media. #LibertyUniversity #SocialMedia #Fasting

item.title: Kansas lawmakers override Democrat governor's veto of trans bathroom: 'Prioritizes privacy, safety over ideology'
item.description: Kansas lawmakers have overridden a veto from Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly on a bill that prohibits men who identify as women from entering restrooms and locker rooms designated for women and girls. #Kansas #veto #override #transgender #LGBT #bathroombill #ADF #ACLU

item.title: Parents warned that 764 child exploitation network can easily 'turn a kid’s screen into a trap'
item.description: A parental advocacy group is encouraging parents to remain vigilant, warning that children can easily be manipulated by an international child exploitation organization on their mobile devices. #AmericanParentsCoalition #FBI #DepartmentofJustice #764network #Childexploitation

item.title: Tucker Carlson alleges mistreatment, detention by Israeli officials after spending several hours in Ben Gurion Airport for Huckabee interview
item.description: Tucker Carlson, the former Fox News anchor who has drawn flak for his ferocious anti-Israel activism in recent months, added more controversy on Wednesday by claiming Israeli officials detained him before his departure, which the Airport Authority and the U.S. embassy denied. #TuckerCarlson #Israel #US #MikeHuckabee

item.title: Christian, Muslim leaders join forces, criticize Nigerian gov't response to mass killings, displacement
item.description: Christian, Muslim and traditional leaders in Nigeria are banding together as part of a new interfaith effort to find solutions and demand protection from their government, as thousands of civilians are killed each year by communal clashes, banditry and terrorism that has displaced millions over the last decade-plus. #Nigeria #Muslim #Christian #Pastor #Imam #Islam

item.title: Evangelical group speak out in support of Bible Day amid debate
item.description: The Evangelical Alliance of Guatemala has issued a public statement expressing concern about the polarization surrounding Decree 5-2025, legislation that established the observance of Bible Day and is currently under review by the Constitutional Court. #EvangelicalAllianceofGuatemala #BibleDay #religiousfreedom

item.title: Trump briefed on multiple Iran strike options as more US forces move into region
item.description: U.S. military units continue to arrive in the Middle East, as the USS Gerald Ford aircraft carrier is expected to enter the Mediterranean Sea later this week, according to USNI News. #Iran #Trump #USA

item.title: ‘The Lord is doing a work’: Kentucky Baptist youth event breaks attendance record
item.description: A two-day youth evangelism gathering of the Kentucky Baptist Convention drew a record number of attendees, with more than 1,300 mostly young people participating. #Kentucky #youth #evangelism #summit #Baptists #revival #ministry

item.title: Conservative alternative to UMC now has over 7,000 member congregations
item.description: A theologically conservative denomination founded as an alternative to the United Methodist Church now has more than 7,000 member congregations, months after surpassing 6,000. #GlobalMethodistChurch #UnitedMethodistChurch #LGBT #churches #evangelism #growth
